# Disclosure

Shows or hides a section; an accordion is a list of them.

- Status: implemented
- Category: container
- Pattern: WAI-ARIA APG “disclosure”; HTML `<button aria-expanded aria-controls>`
- Text style: `body` (`.nd-text-body`)

## Anatomy

- **toggle**: A real button with the label and a chevron that turns.
- **note** (optional): Why the section is optional.
- **body**: Hidden with the hidden attribute when closed.

## Variants

- `single`: One section.
- `accordion`: Several; headings wrap the toggles.

## States

- `collapsed`
- `expanded`: The chevron turns; aria-expanded.
- `hover`
- `focus-visible`

## Keyboard

| Keys | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Enter, Space | Toggles. |

## Accessibility

- Role: button with aria-expanded
- Name: Its label.

WCAG 2.2 success criteria:

- 1.3.1 Info and Relationships (A)
- 2.1.1 Keyboard (A)
- 2.4.7 Focus Visible (AA)
- 2.4.13 Focus Appearance (AAA)
- 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value (A)

## Web example

From the reference page:

```html
<div class="nd-details">
  <button
    type="button"
    class="nd-details__toggle"
    aria-expanded="false"
    aria-controls="ex-details"
  >
    <span class="nd-details__label">More options</span>
    <span class="nd-details__mark" aria-hidden="true"
      ><svg
        class="nd-icon nd-icon--down"
        viewBox="0 0 24 24"
        fill="none"
        aria-hidden="true"
        focusable="false"
      >
        <path
          d="M12 4.5 6.3 10.2l1.2 1.2 3.6-3.6v12h1.8v-12l3.6 3.6 1.2-1.2z"
          fill="currentColor"
        /></svg
    ></span>
    <span class="nd-details__note">optional</span>
  </button>
  <div class="nd-details__body" id="ex-details" hidden>
    The hidden section.
  </div>
</div>
```
